ideas.recipe: E[max(0, 1-O/R) | R>=1], R~Poisson(lambda); lambda is the preregistered P2 RUCA/area expected fire count. The sum truncates at 12 standard deviations + 40 counts; tested against direct PMF sums; no fitted parameters.

ideas.reason: The current estimator inputs are tract-scoped totals. This recipe requires O/E ratios at tract, tract-plus-first-ring and county scales, including first-ring neighbor membership and consistent count/area aggregation. The harness has no tested neighbor/scale aggregation interface, so a slope cannot be produced without constructing an unvalidated assignment.
ideas.missing_prerequisite: A validated first-ring adjacency and aggregation API with exact county and multi-scale count/expectation fixtures.

ideas.reason: Centroid, intersection and largest-overlap rules require raw per-feature geometry and identity for buildings, POIs and roads, plus per-tract assigned counts. Existing feature cache values are already tract-aggregated; the current raw road method only measures clipped lengths and does not implement paired assignment modes.
ideas.missing_prerequisite: Per-feature, rule-clean input access and tested centroid/intersection/largest-overlap assignments for each required source, with count conservation checks.

ideas.reason: The Clark-Evans places/buildings ratio needs both point patterns. A verified places source/accessor is not available (the eastern-OK places object path previously returned FileNotFound), and no per-place coordinates are exposed through the harness. Small-n handling cannot be established absent those points.
ideas.missing_prerequisite: Verified all-region places coordinates and a tested point-pattern/low-count implementation for places and buildings.

ideas.reason: The recipe enumerates probabilistic definedness patterns for three components and needs probability inputs from expectation ideas (including P3/X1) plus component gap estimates. These inputs are not all implemented or available: current P implementations provide P2 fire and P4 rural-road estimates only, and P4 is a hard applicability mask, not a probability.
ideas.missing_prerequisite: Implemented/pre-registered probability estimates for all required component sources (including P3/X1) and a three-component expected-composite contract; do not substitute hard flags.

redundancy.merge_action: P2 and Sca1 are retained and flagged, not silently dropped. Treat the pair as one correlated feature group for combiner decisions; Sca1 is an alternative Poisson-corrected P2 formulation, not an independent evidence source. The next combiner must merge/group them or justify retaining both; no learned weights were fitted in this study-side work.

orthogonality.note: Every implemented idea was recomputed label-free; unimplemented Sca2-Sca5 have no invented correlations or VIF.
